issue_context.title: Failure to parse single-digit months or dates
issue_context.body:
### Polars version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Issue description

Chrono allows single-digit months to be parsed with `'%m'`

But Polar's fastpath parser doesn't allow that, so it fails:

### Reproducible example

```python
In [6]: pl.Series(['2020-1-1']).str.strptime(pl.Datetime, '%Y-%m-%d')
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ComputeError                              Traceback (most recent call last)
Cell In [6], line 1
----> 1 pl.Series(['2020-1-1']).str.strptime(pl.Datetime, '%Y-%m-%d')


ComputeError: strict conversion to dates failed, maybe set strict=False
```


### Expected behavior

```python
In [1]: pl.Series(['2020-1-1']).str.strptime(pl.Datetime, '%Y-%m-%d')
Out[1]: 
shape: (1,)
Series: '' [datetime[μs]]
[
        2020-01-01 00:00:00
]
```

Looks like the fallback couldn't be removed, as was done in https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/7369 (apologies!) - so here I'm restoring it, but using `transform` so it'll handle the cases which https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/7373 addressed

### Installed versions

```

Polars: 0.16.11
Index type: UInt32
Platform: Linux-5.10.102.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2-x86_64-with-glibc2.35

[GCC 11.3.0]
```

</details>
